info.title: PDM API
info.description: Plant, crop and garden health monitoring.

get.summary:
`GET /connectors/oauth/callback?code&state&error`: the vendor's redirect. Public: no session
can say who consented, so it checks the state (signature, expiry, and that the pending
connector still holds its nonce), stores nothing, and answers `302` to the app with the
code and state, or the vendor's `error` (the owner declined). `400 invalid_request` for a
bad, expired or used state; `409 invalid_state` while connectors are off.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The authorization code; absent when the owner declined.

302.description: To the app with `code` and `state`, or `error` and `state`

delete.summary:
`DELETE /connectors/{id}`: `202`. The store marks the connector `deleting` (the list and the
sync skip it), then a background task revokes the tokens with the vendor and deletes the
records and the connector. Owner. `409 invalid_state` while connectors are off and for a
demo connector.

get.summary:
`GET /connectors/{id}/available-sources`: the channels the bot is in, or the folders. Owner.
`409 invalid_state` while connectors are off, for a demo connector, or one with no token
yet; a token the vendor refuses makes the connector `reauth_needed` and is `409` too.

post.summary:
`POST /connectors/{id}/complete`: exchanges the code. The owner who started the connect, with
the `device_verifier` whose hash started it; anyone else, or a wrong verifier, gets
`404 not_found` and the pending connector is deleted. `400 invalid_request` for a bad,
expired or used state, or a code the vendor refused; `409 invalid_state` while connectors are
off.
post.description:
The timeout is 60 s. Past it the answer is `503`, but the exchange runs on: a retry with the
same `Idempotency-Key` gets `409 request_in_progress` until it ends, and then its answer when
that is a `2xx` or a deterministic `4xx` (the only answers stored); after a `5xx` the key is
released and the retry runs again.

put.summary:
`PUT /connectors/{id}/sources`: Slack up to 10 channels, Drive 1 folder, each from
`available-sources` (its name comes from there). Owner. The records of a source no longer
chosen are deleted before the answer. `409 invalid_state` while connectors are off, for a
demo connector, or one with no token yet.

post.summary:
`POST /connectors/{id}/sync`: **Sync now**, `202`; `429 rate_limited` with `retry_after_s`
within 5 minutes of the last accepted request (decision 12, a compare-and-set in the store).
Owner. `409 invalid_state` while connectors are off, for a demo connector, one that isn't
`active`, or one stopped until its sources change. It has no body and holds no idempotency
record: a repeat inside 5 minutes is the `429`, so it is naturally idempotent.

get.summary:
`GET /conversations?garden_id=&anchor_type=&anchor_id=`: the caller's own, newest
`last_message_at` first.

parameters.name: anchor_id
parameters.description: Filter by anchor id (a ULID of the anchor type's table).

post.summary: `POST /conversations`: anchored to a scan, plant or garden of the garden. Any member.

get.summary: `GET /conversations/{id}`: with its messages, newest first. Owner of the conversation.

post.summary:
`POST /conversations/{id}/images`: the scan upload's pipeline, without the quality check and
depth.

get.summary: `GET /conversations/{id}/images/{image_id}?exp=&sig=`: a chat image.

post.summary:
`POST /conversations/{id}/messages`: the agent's turn as SSE, events without `id:` lines (not
resumable). Errors before the stream starts (budget, validation) are ordinary error bodies.
post.description:
The stream is the agent's `'static` event stream mapped to SSE frames. If the client goes
away, hyper drops the body, which drops the agent's receiver; the turn task sees its next send
fail, stops the LLM call and stores the message with `interrupted: true`. Shutdown ends the
stream through `take_until`, the same way.

The idempotency record finishes when the turn task reports its outcome: a completed message is
stored as the replay `200 { message }`; an interrupted or failed one releases the key, so the
app's "resend", with a new key, runs again.

200.description: `event: name`, `data: ChatEvent`; a replay is `application/json` MessageReplay

get.summary: `GET /gardens`: the caller's gardens, by name. Any signed-in user.

post.summary:
`POST /gardens`: the caller becomes owner; `SoilGrids` is fetched in the background, and the
scheduler retries it when it fails.

get.summary: `GET /gardens/{id}`. Any member.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /gardens/{id}`: `202`; the cascade runs in the background and the other members get
a `garden_deleted` push. Owner.

get.summary:
`GET /gardens/{id}/connectors`: the garden's connectors with their sources, last sync and
record counts. Any member. `available: false` with an empty list while connectors are off.

post.summary:
`POST /gardens/{id}/connectors`: starts a connect, `pending`, and returns the vendor's consent
URL. Owner. `409 invalid_state` while connectors are off, when this server has no OAuth
client for the vendor, or when the garden already has 2 connectors.

get.summary: `GET /gardens/{id}/invites`: unused and unexpired, newest first. Owner.

post.summary: `POST /gardens/{id}/invites`: a single-use code, valid 7 days. Owner.

get.summary: `GET /gardens/{id}/map`: the current map or `null`. Any member.

put.summary:
`PUT /gardens/{id}/map`: a new version, atomic; `409 invalid_state` with
`current_map_version` when `base_version` is stale, `400` with every unknown plant. Editor.

get.summary: `GET /gardens/{id}/members`, by `since`. Any member.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /gardens/{id}/members/{user_id}`: an owner removing anyone, or a member leaving
(the role check depends on the request, so it is the run-time `require`). Their chats in the
garden go with them; the last owner can't leave (`409`).

patch.summary:
`PATCH /gardens/{id}/members/{user_id}`: change a role; demoting the last owner is `409`.
Owner.

get.summary:
`GET /gardens/{id}/weather`: the garden's cache cell for this hour, fetched on a miss as a scan
does. `503 upstream_unavailable` when the fetch fails. Any member.
`GET /healthz`: `200 { ok: true }` when `SurrealDB` and `RustFS` answer; `503` otherwise.

post.summary:
`POST /internal/jobs/claim`: the long poll, up to `wait_s` (default 25, at most 30). `200 Job`,
or `204` when nothing arrived (also on shutdown, so the worker reconnects). A claim that moved
the scan from `queued` to `analysing` emits that `status_changed` here.

`POST /internal/jobs/{id}/complete`: the result, read by the job's recorded kind (contracts
v0.9), or a failure. `204` also for a repeat with the same token after completion. A job out
of attempts fails for good inside `Pipeline::job_completed` (the scan, the question or the
guided check, by kind), whose follow-up comes back in `handled`: it is applied once.

`POST /internal/jobs/{id}/events`: stage events and partial results, turned into scan events
by the pipeline (a partial result's findings, or `finding_retracted` when it changed).
`measurement` is never a worker stage: `api` reports it itself. Events that arrive after the
job completed with the same token (a late batch) get `204` and are dropped, never forwarded:
the result is final and its events were sent at `complete`.

get.summary:
`GET /internal/jobs/{id}/images/{image_id}`: a job's image, authorised by its lease: only an
image the job's payload names, only while the lease holds.

post.summary:
`POST /internal/workers/heartbeat`: every 10 s. Extends the listed leases (only the worker's
own, never past `claimed_at + max_runtime`), records `versions` for `/status`, and answers
the jobs to stop.

`POST /invites/{code}/accept`: any signed-in user, 10 attempts a minute (`429`). Unknown, used,
revoked or expired codes are `404`; an existing member gets `200` with their role unchanged.

get.summary: `GET /me`. The user record was created on first sight by `AuthUser` if the webhook hadn't yet.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /me`: `202` with what happens to each garden; the cascade runs in the background and
ends with the account's deletion at Clerk, retried until it succeeds (across restarts, through
the account's tombstone). A repeat while the cascade runs starts nothing; the token is
refused (`401`) once the tombstone exists, so a repeat usually never gets this far.

patch.summary:
`PATCH /me`: withdrawing location consent rounds every garden the user owns to about 10 km,
in the store's transaction.

post.summary: `POST /me/push-tokens`: `204`; registering the same token again is a no-op.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /me/push-tokens/{token}`: the token is URL-encoded in the path (`[` and `]`); axum's
path extractor percent-decodes it.

get.summary:
`GET /memories?garden_id=&plant_id=`: shared memories plus the caller's own chat memories,
newest first. Any member.

post.summary: `POST /memories`: a garden note, `source: "user"`, embedded on CPU. Editor.

delete.summary: `DELETE /memories/{id}`: the author of a chat memory; an owner for shared memories.

post.summary: `POST /memories/{id}/share`: the chat memory's author, if an editor or owner.
`POST /messages/{id}/feedback`: `204`; the conversation's owner, assistant messages only.

`POST /pending-actions/{id}/confirm`: the conversation's owner, an editor or owner of the
garden.
post.description:
| State | Result |
|---|---|
| `confirmed` (a retry) | `200` with the first result |
| `rejected`, `expired`, or past `expires_at` | `409 invalid_state` with `status` |
| `proposed`, a task card | the task is created (source `chat`) or completed; a plant deleted since: `409` with `hint: "plant_removed"` |
| `proposed`, a plan card | under the scan's plan lock: the preview applied to the current plan exactly as shown, stored as a new version with reason `chat_revision`; a base that is no longer current: `409` with `current_plan_id`; a neighbour deleted since: `409` with `hint: "neighbour_removed"`. Never retried |

post.summary: `POST /pending-actions/{id}/reject`: `200 { pending_action }`.

get.summary: `GET /plants?garden_id=`: by name. Any member.

post.summary:
`POST /plants`. Editor. A `species_id` the knowledge base doesn't hold is `400
invalid_request`, checked in the store's transaction.

get.summary: `GET /plants/{id}`. Any member.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /plants/{id}`: `202`; the cascade (its scans, tasks, the tasks other plans made for
it, conversations, memories, its pin) runs in the background. Owner.

get.summary:
`GET /plants/{id}/beliefs`: what is believed about the plant now (its current beliefs and its
garden's) and its superseded beliefs, newest first, from Agent Memory. Shared memories only,
so any member. Never a 5xx: Agent Memory off, failing or slower than 3 s is
`available: false` with empty lists.
`GET /plants/{id}/measurements?quantity=`: the growth series, oldest first. Any member.

post.summary:
`POST /plants/{id}/species`: confirm or correct; the plant's most recent scan follows it, a
new run when it is past `queued` ([contracts 3]). Editor.

get.summary: `GET /plants/{id}/timeline`: newest first, with signed thumbnails. Any member.

post.summary:
`POST /scans`: a scan in `pending`, with a new plant when `new_plant` is given. Counts toward
the daily scan limit (30), in the scan's transaction (`429 budget_exceeded`).

get.summary: `GET /scans/{id}`: the detail, with fresh signed URLs.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /scans/{id}`: only a `pending` scan (`409 invalid_state` with `status` otherwise,
checked in the store's transaction). `deleting_at` is set first, then the cascade runs in the
background.

post.summary: `POST /scans/{id}/answers`: an indicator question's answer; rescored in the background.

get.summary:
`GET /scans/{id}/events`: the resumable SSE stream ([`scan_stream`]). Everything that can
fail with an `ErrorBody` happens before the first byte: authentication, membership (`404` for
non-members) and `Last-Event-ID` parsing.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: The last seq the app applied

200.description: `id: seq`, `event: type`, `data: ScanEvent`; `: keepalive` every 15 s

post.summary: `POST /scans/{id}/feedback`: reviewer or above; `409 invalid_state` while `pending`.

`POST /scans/{id}/images`: see [`uploads`]. The multipart body is read whole (within its
caps) before the idempotency record begins, because the fingerprint covers every part.

requestBody.description: kind, file, question_id?, depth?, depth_confidence?, depth_meta?

get.summary: `GET /scans/{id}/images/{image_id}?exp=&sig=`: the face-blurred photo, `image/webp`.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /scans/{id}/images/{image_id}`: while `pending`; the photo's depth and confidence
maps go with it, deleted detached.

get.summary: `GET /scans/{id}/masks/{mask_id}?exp=&sig=`: a segmentation mask, `image/png`.

post.summary:
`POST /scans/{id}/submit`: no body. `202` when a run starts, `200` when nothing changes
(submit is idempotent); `409 invalid_state` with `hint: "new_scan"` after a non-retryable
failure; `422 missing_required_shot`.

get.summary: `GET /species?q=`: by common name; `q` matches common and scientific names anywhere.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Matches common and scientific names, case-insensitively, anywhere in the name.

get.summary: `GET /species/{id}`: an unknown slug is `404`.
`GET /species/{id}/images/{hash}?exp=&sig=`: a species reference photo from `knowledge/`.

`GET /status`: worker health, their model versions (contracts v0.9 keys) and the queue. No
user data.

`GET /tasks?garden_id=&source=&state=`: by `due` (none last), then `created_at`.
`?source=forecast_alert` is the alert inbox. Any member.

post.summary:
`POST /tasks`: `source: "user"`. A plant or scan that isn't live in the garden is `404`,
checked in the insert's transaction. Editor.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /tasks/{id}`: `user` and `chat` tasks only; plan and forecast-alert tasks are
dismissed instead (`409 invalid_state`), so the scheduler never recreates one. Editor.

patch.summary:
`PATCH /tasks/{id}`: complete, dismiss, or edit a `user` or `chat` task. Completing a repeating
task creates the next occurrence in the same transaction. Editor.

post.summary:
`POST /webhooks/auth`: Clerk through Svix. The raw body is verified (signature over
`id.timestamp.body`, timestamp within 5 minutes either way) **before** it is parsed; a bad
signature or timestamp is `401 unauthenticated` (contracts 9, auth webhook). `user.deleted` starts the
account cascade. `user.created` is acknowledged and changes nothing: the user record is made
by the first authenticated request, and Clerk doesn't guarantee event order, so a late
`user.created` must never recreate a deleted user. Idempotent: `204` every time, also for
event types it doesn't handle and for a signed body the adapter can't read (Svix would retry
it forever).

AccountDeletion.description: `202` of `DELETE /me`. The cascade runs in the background (architecture 5, deletion).

citations.description: Every source the steps cite, resolved.

diagnosis_id.description: The diagnosis this version was written from.

farm_records.description: Every farm record the steps cite, resolved ([connectors 7]); absent when empty.

open_question.description: The question still open when this version was written.

provisional.description: True exactly when the diagnosis it was written from is `uncertain`.

watch_for.description: "New spots on upper leaves within 5 days".

Answer.description: `"yes" | "no" | "unsure"`: question options, indicator answers and evidence.

AvailableSources.description:
`GET /connectors/{id}/available-sources` (owner): the channels the bot is a member of, or
the folders.

sources.description: What the owner may choose from.

items.description: confidence from 0 to 1

BBox.description: [x, y, w, h], normalised to the stored image

id.description: The app's own id, unique within the map.

polygon_m.description: Ground plane, metres; 3–50 points, a simple polygon.

Belief.description:
A shared memory as Agent Memory holds it ([contracts 8], beliefs): the current value of one
key of a plant or of its garden, or, in `PlantBeliefs.history`, an earlier one.

learned_at.description: When it was learned: the memory's `created_at`.

memory_id.description: The memory it was recorded from; absent if Agent Memory lost the label.

superseded_at.description: When a newer memory on the same key replaced it; absent while it is current.

indicators.description:
Its 3 discriminating indicators, minus those a measurement settled; a candidate with
none left is not sent.

score.description: Sum of matched weights minus contradicted weights.

Card.description: `PendingAction.card`; the labels are written by the server.

body.description: "Spray the tomato with water to knock off aphids".

ChatErrorEvent.description: `error` data: an error after the stream started; the stream ends.

ChatEvent.description:
One chat SSE event ([contracts 8], sending a message). The `data:` line carries the
variant's fields only, and the SSE `event:` line is [`ChatEvent::event_name`]; the stream is
not resumable, so events have no `id:`. Serialize only: the API writes these and the app
reads them.

Citation.description:
`Citation` ([contracts 7]): a curated source. Its `url` is the source's public page, not an
image, so it is a plain string.

slots.description: As in the heartbeat; a worker already holding `slots` jobs gets `204`.

CompleteConnectorRequest.description: `POST /connectors/{id}/complete` (the owner who started it): exchanges the code.

code.description: The vendor's authorization code, from the redirect to the app.

device_verifier.description: The 32 random bytes whose hash started the connect.

state.description: The state from the same redirect.

CompleteJob.description:
`POST /internal/jobs/{id}/complete` ([contracts 5]). A repeat with the same lease token for
a completed job returns `204` and changes nothing.

ConfidenceBand.description:
`"high" | "medium" | "low"`, computed by the API so every screen agrees ([contracts 1]):
**high** ≥ 0.8, **medium** ≥ 0.5, **low** below that.

ConfirmSpeciesRequest.description: `POST /plants/{id}/species` ([contracts 3]). Exactly one of the two fields.

custom_name.description: "Something else", at most 80 characters: the plant is treated as unsupported.

Connector.description:
`Connector` ([connectors 5]): what `GET /gardens/{id}/connectors` lists and the connect
calls return. Tokens and the pending connect's state are never part of it.

account.description: The connected workspace or account; absent while `pending`.

endpoint.description: `vendor`, or `era` for the demo garden's synthetic data.

record_count.description: Synced records (chunks) held for the garden by this connector.

sources.description: The chosen channels (Slack, up to 10) or folder (Drive, 1); empty until chosen.

synced_at.description: When the last sync finished; absent before the first.

team_id.description: The workspace's team id; one pacer and one token per team.

url.description: The workspace URL, which permalinks are built from.

ConnectorAccount.description: `Connector.account`: whose workspace or Drive was connected, tagged by `kind`.

ConnectorEndpoint.description:
`Connector.endpoint` ([connectors 9.4]): where the connector's vendor calls go. Set by server
configuration only; no route creates an `era` connector.

ConnectorList.description:
`GET /gardens/{id}/connectors` ([connectors 11]). `available: false` when connectors are off
on this server (no `CONNECTOR_KEY`), with an empty list, as beliefs do.

available.description: Connectors are configured on this server.

connectors.description: The garden's connectors, oldest first; empty when not available.

ConnectorSource.description: A chosen source: a Slack channel or the Drive folder.

id.description: The vendor's id: a channel id (`"C024BE91L"`) or a folder id.

ConsentPrecision.description: `GardenLocationInput.precision`: what the phone's location consent allows.

last_message_at.description: When the last message was sent.

title.description: A title, once one is generated.

CreateConnectorResponse.description:
`POST /gardens/{id}/connectors`' answer: the `pending` connector and the vendor's consent
URL, opened with `openAuthSessionAsync`.

authorize_url.description: The vendor's consent page, with `state` = HMAC(connector, nonce, expiry).

anchor.description: What the conversation is about; must be in the garden.

plant_id.description: The plant, or none for the garden.

topic.description: What the note is about; `other` when absent.

CreateTaskRequest.description:
`POST /tasks`: `source: "user"`. A `plant_id` or `scan_id` that isn't live in the garden
gets `404`, checked in the insert's transaction.

plant_id.description: A live plant of the garden.

scan_id.description: A live scan of the garden (and of that plant): the jar-test task.

region.description: The box, when the model gave one.

DepthInfo.description: `ScanImage.depth`: present for `LiDAR` shots; the depth map itself is never served.

has_gravity.description: Plant height and canopy width need gravity.

oneOf.description: The depth (and confidence map) were stored.
The photo was stored without its depth.

DepthOutcome.description:
`UploadImageResponse.depth`: `{ stored: true } | { stored: false, problem }`. The union is
tagged by a boolean, which serde can't tag on, so it is untagged with [`True`] and [`False`]
literal fields that only deserialise from their own value.

DepthProblem.description: Why depth sent with a photo was dropped ([contracts 3]).

low_evidence.description: `uncertain`, and nothing points to any problem.

soil.description: The soil observations used, guided checks included.

supersedes.description: The earlier diagnosis of the same scan.

preys_on.description:
Beneficial only: the pests it eats. Filled in when read, never stored: the store drops it
on write and `api` fills it from `KnowledgeStore::prey_of`.

reporting_url.description: Invasive only: the app shows "How to report".

DiagnosisStatus.description: `Diagnosis.status`, decided in the order of contracts 7's table.

region_id.description: Absent when the classifier ran on the whole close-up.

top.description: Top 3, restricted to the working species' labels.

required_role.description: The lowest role that may make the call.

job_id.description: The job whose lease is gone.

blur_score.description: The blur score (variance of the Laplacian).

missing.description: The required kinds that are missing.

upstream.description: The dependency that failed, such as `"llm"` or `"open_meteo"`.

ErrorKind.description:
The `code` and `details` pair of an error body, tagged as contracts 2 lays them out: `code`
beside the other fields, and `details` only for the codes that define it.

message.description: Human-readable, safe to show; English for now.

retryable.description: The same request may succeed later.

EventSeq.description:
A scan event's `seq` and SSE `id`: per scan, from 1, strictly increasing, without gaps,
across all runs ([contracts 4]).

EvidenceBasis.description: `Diagnosis.evidence_basis` (architecture 6.4: user input, then photo, then modelled data).

EvidenceSource.description:
`IndicatorEvidence.source`, ranked `user` > `measurement` > `vlm`: each indicator keeps one
answer ([contracts 7], measurable indicators).

FarmCitation.description:
`FarmCitation` ([connectors 7]): a synced farm record cited by a plan step or an assistant
message. Stored with the plan or message as it was, so a deleted record's citation stays.

at.description: The message's time, or the document's `modifiedTime`.

link.description: Opens the record in Slack or Drive (or, for an `era` connector, the simulator).

FeedbackRequest.description:
`POST /scans/{id}/feedback` ([contracts 3]): stored with the author's user id; deleted with
their account.

corrected_label.description: Free text, or a slug when picked from a list.

frost_risk.description:
Frost expected: the 2 m minimum at or below `WeatherThresholds::frost_min_c` (0.5 °C by
default), set when the cell is fetched (`domain::rules::weather`).

location_precision.description: How precise the stored location is.

city.description: Without consent, instead of a postal code: "Guelph, ON"; geocoded once.

created_by.description: Absent once that user is deleted.

pins.description: Pins, leaving out plants being deleted.

version.description: The version; only the current one is kept.

base_version.description: The version current when the mapping session started; 0 when the garden had none.

north_deg.description:
0–360, clockwise from the map's +y axis to north; only with a compass accuracy of 20° or
better.

pins.description: At most 200; a plant appears at most once.

weather.description: The garden's cache cell for the current hour.

Healthz.description: `GET /healthz`: `200 { ok: true }` when `SurrealDB` and `RustFS` are reachable.

gpu.description: The GPU, when it has one.

slots.description: The most jobs it holds at once.

Id.description: ULID record key, without the table prefix

IndicatorWhere.description: `IndicatorWhere` ([contracts 10]): where on the plant an indicator shows.

InvalidRequestDetails.description:
`details` of `invalid_request`. `plant_ids` is set only for the map upload's
`problem: "unknown_plant"` ([contracts 9], garden map).

field.description: The field at fault, as a dotted path (`"location.lat"`, `"pins"`).

plant_ids.description: Every pinned plant that isn't a plant of this garden.

InvalidStateDetails.description:
`details` of `invalid_state`. Every field is optional; the record's state is reported as a
string because the record may be a scan, question, plan, task, invite, pending action or map.

allowed.description: The states that would allow the call.

current_plan_id.description: A plan revision's base is no longer current.

status.description: The record's current state, such as `"planned"` or `"rejected"`.

code.description: 26 random base32 characters (128 bits); shared as a link.

created_by.description: Who made it; absent once that user is deleted (contracts v0.9, `created_by?: Id`).

lease_token.description: Sent as `X-Lease-Token` on every later call.

lease_until.description: When the lease ends unless a heartbeat extends it.

max_runtime_s.description: The kind's `max_runtime`, doubled on the fallback worker.

run.description: Absent for guided jobs, which don't belong to a run.

JobError.description: `CompleteJob.error` ([contracts 5]): job errors travel here, never as HTTP status codes.

JobErrorCode.description: unsupported_version | unknown_label_version | model_error | image_fetch_failed | max_runtime_exceeded, or another string

JobImage.description:
`JobImage` ([contracts 5]). `url` is the worker route
`GET /internal/jobs/{job_id}/images/{image_id}`, authorised by the lease token; it is not
signed and never expires, so it is a [`WorkerImagePath`] and may be stored in the payload.

url.description: The worker route for its bytes.

JobOutcome.description:
`status` with `result` (done) or `error` (failed), flattened into [`CompleteJob`]. The tag
makes the other combinations unrepresentable.

JobSpec.description:
`kind` and `payload` side by side ([contracts 5], `Job`): adjacently tagged, flattened into
[`Job`]. Stored as `job.kind` and `job.payload`.

KnowledgeRef.description:
`Observation.ref`: the knowledge-base record, when there is one. Adjacently tagged, so it
serialises as `{ "table": "disease", "id": "tomato_early_blight" }`.

LatestScan.description:
`Plant.latest_scan`: the plant's most recent scan, in any status, skipping scans being
deleted ([contracts 3], deleting a scan).

thumbnail_image_id.description: Its `whole_plant` shot, when it has one.

LocalDate.description:
A calendar date in the garden's time zone, `YYYY-MM-DD` ([contracts 1]). A newtype over
`chrono::NaiveDate` (whose serde form is already `"2026-10-20"`) so the `OpenAPI` and JSON
Schema generators see `format: date` through any alias, and so a UTC day can't be passed
where a garden-local one is meant without saying so.

oneOf.description: `null` when the garden has no map.

location_consent.description: Whether gardens may store GPS coordinates.

MeasureQuantity.description: `MeasureQuantity` ([contracts 7]). The unit is in the name.

PartialResult.description:
`PartialResult` ([contracts 5]): the complete output of one finished stage, tagged by its
own `stage`.

hours_rh_over_90.description: Hours with RH over 90%: the leaf-wetness stand-in.

longest_humid_run_days.description:
The longest run of consecutive humid days in the past 7, each a local day with at least
`WeatherThresholds::humid_day_hours` hours over 90% (0–7), computed from the hourly
history when the cell is fetched (`WeatherThresholds::longest_humid_run`), so a humid
stretch in the past week is detectable ([contracts 9], crowding; architecture 6.8).
`#[serde(default)]` reads weather cached or snapshotted before the field existed as 0;
the wire always carries it.

images.description:
Every plant and soil image of the scan, or only a question's photo; never guided-check
images, never depth.

question_id.description:
Set on a question photo's segmentation-only job: `stages` is `["segmentation"]`,
`images` holds that photo alone, and nothing it returns can fail the scan.

regions.description: From an earlier run, when segmentation isn't re-run.

skip_species_identification.description: True when the user chose "something else" (no `species_id`). Omitted when false.

species_id.description: Confirmed or user-chosen species: skip identification, use this.

mask.description: The API stores it as a PNG and serves it through a signed URL.

canopy_radius_m.description: From the reconstructed mesh; shown, not used by any rule.

new_plant.description: A plant created with the upload.

PlanConstraint.description: `ActionPlan.constraints[]`: from confirmed chat revisions; carried into every later version.

from_pending_action_id.description: The confirmed card; an id, not a link (the card may be deleted with its conversation).

category.description: From the treatment's `kind` when there is one; `chemical` when a product is named.

farm_citations.description:
Farm records the step cites ([connectors 7]): the farm's history, never the advice, so a
step still needs a knowledge source. Each appears in `ActionPlan.farm_records`.
Absent when empty; a plan stored before connectors reads as citing none.

plant_id.description: A neighbour this monitoring step is about; its task goes to that plant.

safety_note.description: Added by the server to every chemical step.

targets.description: What it acts on; may be empty.

treatment_id.description: The knowledge-base treatment the step applies.

oneOf.description: An organism; never a beneficial one.

id.description: An organism; never a beneficial one.

PlanTarget.description: `PlanStep.targets[]`: what the step acts on, `{ table, id }`.

oneOf.description: A task due on that date.
A repeating task: "check for new spots every 3 days".

until.description: The last date a task is created for.

oneOf.description: No task yet: a plan trigger rule creates it when it fires.

species.description: The working species, suggested or confirmed.

species_status.description: Whether the species is suggested or confirmed.

PlantBeliefs.description:
`GET /plants/{plant_id}/beliefs`: what is believed about a plant now, and what was believed
before. Shared memories only, so every member may read it.

available.description: `false` when Agent Memory isn't configured or didn't answer; both lists are then empty.

current.description: The plant's current beliefs and its garden's, one per key.

history.description: The plant's superseded beliefs, newest first.

map_version.description: The map version the pin is on.

x_m.description: Metres on the map's ground plane.

y_m.description: Metres on the map's ground plane.

oneOf.description: A task to create or complete.

task.description: The task as it would be stored.

oneOf.description: A plan revision, stored exactly as shown when confirmed.

base_plan_id.description: The plan the revision is based on.

changed_steps.description: Replace the base plan's step with the same id, or add a new one.

Prey.description:
`Diagnosis.organisms[].preys_on[]`: computed from the `preys_on` graph when read; never
stored.

PriorRegion.description:
`PerceptionPayload.regions[]`: `Region & { region_id: string; class: RegionClass }` from an
earlier run, when segmentation isn't re-run. The optional `mask_url` of `Region` is never
sent: workers have no route to masks, and species and disease work from the boxes.

PushTokenRequest.description: `POST /me/push-tokens`: registering the same token again is a no-op.

QualityHint.description: One hint per `image_quality` problem, for the app's retake prompt ([contracts 2]).

passed.description: Always `true`: a failing shot gets `422 image_quality` instead.

continue_at.description: When the scheduler continues without an answer.

photo_hint.description: "Turn the leaf over and photograph the underside".

text.description: "Do the spots have rings, like a target?"

QuestionStatus.description:
`Question.status`: what the app sees. The stored lifecycle has three more states, in
[`crate::rules::questions::QuestionState`].

`SpeciesSummary.reference_images[]`.

credit.description: "Photo: A. Author, CC BY-SA 4.0"; shown with the photo.

`SpeciesSummary.reference_images[]`.

credit.description: "Photo: A. Author, CC BY-SA 4.0"; shown with the photo.

allOf.description: The mask slot of a signed region: `mask_url?` of contracts 1.

mask_url.description: Signed PNG mask, when segmentation produced one.

image_id.description: The image the box is on.

region_id.description: Present for segmentation regions, unique within the scan.

(`"<image_id>.<n>"`) and referenced by later stages.

until.description: The last date an occurrence is created for.

drivers.description: "4 days over 90% humidity forecast", "Crowded: nearest plant 30 cm away".

size.description: Height, width of the stored image.

wire order in contracts (`"owner" | "editor" | "viewer" | "reviewer"`) is not the rank.

A scan's run: 0 until submitted, 1 on submit, +1 on a resubmit or a species change
([contracts 3], lifecycle). Jobs, events, observations and diagnoses carry it.

created_by.description: Absent once that user is deleted.

images.description: Every plant, soil and guided-check photo.

open_question.description: Present while a question is unanswered, in any status.

observations.description:

runs).

run.description: The run the event belongs to.

source.description: Why it is in the set.

TimeZone.description:
An IANA time zone name, such as `"America/Toronto"`: sets every `LocalDate` of the garden.
Checked by the geocoder that derives it; `domain` keeps it as text so it needs no time-zone
database.

TimelineEntry.description: `TimelineEntry` ([contracts 9]): newest first, skipping scans being deleted.

measurements.description: Height and width, medium confidence or more.

thumbnail_image_id.description: The `whole_plant` shot, when there is one.

Timestamp.description:
RFC 3339 in UTC with a `Z` suffix, whole seconds on the wire: `"2026-10-18T14:03:22Z"`
([contracts 1]). chrono's own `Serialize` adds a fraction whenever the value has one, and a
clock reading always has one, so the newtype truncates when serialising and keeps full
precision in memory (the store binds the inner `DateTime<Utc>`, [database 2]). There is no
`Timestamp::now()`: every reading goes through the `Clock` port so tests control time.

TriggerKind.description:
`TriggerKind` ([contracts 7]): one vocabulary for forecast alerts, plan triggers and
`Task.trigger`.

role.description: The new role; making someone `owner` adds an owner.

UpdateTaskRequest.description:
`PATCH /tasks/{id}`. Only `user` and `chat` tasks can change `title`, `detail`, `due` and
`repeat`; completing a repeating task creates the next one.

depth.description: Present when depth parts were sent.

`{ user_id: Id; display_name: string }`: `Scan.created_by` and `GardenMap.created_by`,
absent once that user is deleted.

images.description: At most 4; for `new_photo`, the new shot first.

question_id.description: With `new_photo`: the question the photo answers.

VlmFindings.description: `VlmFindings` ([contracts 6]): aliases mapped back to ids, certainty words to numbers.

candidates.description: At most 9; empty when measurements answered every indicator.

indicator_images.description: At most 4, chosen from the indicators; empty when measurements answered all.

worker decodes as `Unknown` and is ignored; an unknown value inside a known event is still
an error, because the API must store it.

oneOf.description: `null` for a name outside the knowledge base.
